changes.title: Visible staircase shortcut
changes.text: The staircase shortcut now appears beside the hotbar by default; an explicitly disabled preference stays disabled.

changes.title: Find stair controls
changes.text: Enabling Automatic Stair Navigation explains where to tap for Stairs Up and Stairs Down.

changes.title: Default stair-control regression
changes.text: Added preference reload checks and a native dungeon test that opens the shortcut without force-enabling it.

changes.title: Verified preparation records
changes.text: Recorded the missing-control cause, local results and remaining Android verification.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I made the staircase shortcut visible by default after finding that the previous test enabled it manually. Players who switched it off keep that choice.
